# evroc_lb_http_route (Data Source)

Looks up an evroc load balancer HTTP route and its request matching rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "evroc_lb_http_route" "web" {
  name = "web-route"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) HTTP route name, unique within the project and region.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project containing the route. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region containing the route. Defaults to the provider region.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified HTTP route reference.
- `hostnames` (Set of String) Hostnames to match, including optional leading *. wildcards. Omit to accept all hostnames accepted by the listener.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `route_id` (String) System-assigned route UUID.
- `rule` (List of Object) Ordered routing rules. A rule without matches is a catch-all. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule))
- `system_labels` (Map of String) System-managed resource labels.
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined resource labels.
